name: Municipal Sanitation Monitoring System
shortDescription: A citizen-centric concept for reporting sanitation issues and routing work to municipal workers.
overview: This hackathon project is intended to support reporting and tracking public sanitation issues such as garbage accumulation and open gutters. The planned workflow includes citizen complaint submission with a photo and location, an officer view for reviewing and assigning complaints, and a worker view for assigned tasks.
objectives: Make it easier for citizens to report public sanitation problems.
Give officers a central view of incoming complaints and task assignment.
Give workers a clear view of assigned work.
features: Planned citizen, worker, and officer interfaces
Photo and location details for complaints
challenges: The prototype needs consistent complaint status and assignment workflows across all three roles.
Map and location functionality should remain usable on smaller screens.
learnings: Designing a multi-role workflow around a civic problem.
Breaking a large hackathon concept into separate views and responsibilities.
results: Prototype in development. Listed features describe the planned workflow and are not a deployed municipal service.
